description.value: Saint Cecilia is a specialty coffee and made-to-order soft-serve ice cream shop in downtown Victoria built around a stay-awhile philosophy — guests are encouraged to bring a book or laptop and settle in. The coffee program rotates weekly through diverse roasters and origins, served as espresso or hand brew, while the ice cream uses locally produced bases from Parachute Ice Cream with fruit sourced from named BC farms. The shop also stocks slow-fashion garments and home-brew coffee equipment, giving it a curated neighbourhood feel well beyond a standard café.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and consistently spells the business 'Saint Cecilia' (with an 'i') across the page title and domain (saint-cecilia.ca), while OSM uses 'Saint Cecelia' (with an 'e') — per rule 12 the website spelling is used and the discrepancy flagged. The website confirms the 535 Yates St, Victoria address and shows an active, detailed menu. Explicit vegan and GF menu items are listed (vegan ice cream base, Cowgirl Cookie Vegan/GF, oat milk); no evidence exists on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Saint Cecelia' (with 'e') but the business website, domain name (saint-cecilia.ca), and all page content consistently use 'Saint Cecilia' (with 'i'). The OSM record likely has a spelling error.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active specialty café in downtown Victoria with a live website and a 2025-03-03 OSM check date confirming it remains open.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly lists Vegan Coconut ice cream base, Cowgirl Cookie (Vegan/GF), and oat milk available for espresso and hot chocolate drinks
